newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Micron Electronics active.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Micron Electronics active.

text.p: Micron Electronics Inc was one of the few stocks trading after the bell Monday after it reported improved second quarter earnings, but its price was unchanged from where it closed, traders said.
"It's at 20-1/2 -- that looks right in line," one trader said. The stock closed up 7/8.
One stock moving after the bell was Rexene Corp, up 5/8 to 14-1/2, traders said.
Rexene's stock had closed unchanged on the day at 13-5/8, but then Huntsman Corp issued a statement reiterating its interest in acquiring Rexene for $16 per share.
Moving down after the bell was Micron Technology Inc, which fell to 42-3/8 from its close of 43-5/8 after releasing second quarter results that were lower than a year ago.
"After the news came out it kept going down, down, down," one trader said of Micron Technology.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 837,700, while session two volume was 2,440,597.
